Screen printing on textiles with paint, frame and squeegee.
A good screen print starts with a clean frame, a flat textile and a test print.
FabLab mainly uses Textile Solid. Be aware that paint types behave differently on light an
Work calmly and evenly. Too much paint or too many pulls can make the edges unclear.
Textile Solid must be heat fixed after the paint is dry. Fixing makes the print washable.
Water-based textile paint is easiest to remove from the screen before it dries.
